item.title: llama.cpp Engine Releases: b11906: ggml-cpu : rewrite concat as one row kernel for all types (#31179)
item.description:
- Every dst row comes from src0 or src1, or for dim 0 from the row of src0 followed by the row of src1, so a single kernel covers every type: a dense source row is one memcpy, quantized types included, and a strided source is copied element by element with the element size known at compile time. - Rows are split across threads instead of i2 alone, which is often 1, and are copied in tiles of 32: for a transposed source the elements are walked in the outer loop, so the rows of a tile read neighboring addresses instead of jumping a full row stride per element. - Add transposed b cases to test_conca...
